title: Statue of Our Lady of Miracles
brief_description: Wooden sculpture of Our Lady of Miracles holding the Infant Jesus.
detailed_description: This wooden sculpture represents Our Lady of Miracles, a revered title of the Virgin Mary in Christian tradition. The figure is shown standing gracefully while carrying the Infant Jesus, symbolizing maternal care, divine protection, and compassion. The statue reflects the influence of Portuguese Colonial religious art in Goa, characterized by flowing robes, devotional expression, and finely carved details. Such sculptures were commonly placed in churches and chapels as objects of prayer and veneration, representing faith, hope, and the spiritual heritage of Goa's Christian community.
